answer: Each agent must burn a scarce ember token to register, and a rotating committee checks that the burn transaction's proof-of-work matches a difficulty spiral that rises with each new identity from the same IP range. At the nadir of an attack, spamming thousands of fake identities means purchasing real burned value per identity, so a sybil farmer's cost grows multiplicatively: (token price × difficulty) × N fake agents, making the attack economically irrational.
